evidence.label: def:p01-bpi-principles
evidence.note: BPI (every nontrivial set-sized Boolean algebra has a prime ideal), ideal extension, filter extension, and the set Ultrafilter Lemma for arbitrary S, stated as ambient set-theoretic schemes.

evidence.label: def:p01-bpi-propositional-compactness
evidence.note: Arbitrary-set-variable propositional compactness: arbitrary set V, finite formulas over p_v, bot, top, neg, and, or; valuations V->2; a finitely satisfied Gamma has one satisfying valuation; empty V covered.

evidence.label: def:p02-arbitrary-prop-language
evidence.note: P2 home: Form(P) for arbitrary P, valuations, and the equivalence statement linked to Definition def:ultrafilter-lemma.

evidence.label: thm:p01-bpi-equivalence
evidence.note: Over ZF: BPI, ideal extension, filter extension and the set Ultrafilter Lemma are equivalent, unrestricted.

evidence.label: annex:p01-bpi-equivalence
evidence.note: Written proof of every direction of the four-way equivalence, using ZF plus the assumed principle only.

evidence.label: thm:p01-bpi-propositional-compactness
evidence.note: Over ZF, arbitrary-set compactness is equivalent to each of the four principles; both directions for arbitrary variable and formula sets.

evidence.label: annex:p01-bpi-propositional-compactness
evidence.note: Ultrafilter extension implies compactness (293-322: truth sets, proper set filter, ultrafilter, valuation by Replacement, induction on formulas). Compactness implies ideal extension (324-350: variables p_b, Boolean-law formulas, finite satisfiability via the finite local lemma, the kernel is a prime ideal containing I).

evidence.label: thm:p02-arbitrary-prop-compactness-bpi
evidence.note: P2 home points to the P1 statements whose proofs are written in the annex.

evidence.label: thm:p01-bpi-propositional-compactness
evidence.note: A fixed enumerable variable set has a separate choice-free proof and must not be used as the arbitrary-set principle.

evidence.label: thm:p01-bpi-propositional-compactness
evidence.note: Explains the choice strength; the fixed binary-tree route of sec:p06-cardinals-choice is not strengthened.

evidence.label: annex:p01-bpi-propositional-compactness
evidence.note: The proof uses the variable set indexed by all of B; the Part 6 binary-tree argument for a fixed enumerable alphabet uses its enumeration and no ultrafilter principle; the two have different domains.

evidence.label: thm:p02-arbitrary-prop-compactness-bpi
evidence.note: thm:prop-compactness (fixed countable alphabet, explicit enumeration via lem:prop-lindenbaum, no BPI) is weaker; the arbitrary-language theorem does not upgrade the source proof.

evidence.label: thm:prop-compactness
evidence.note: Countable-alphabet compactness theorem with its written proof on route.

evidence.label: def:p06-countable-compactness-route
evidence.note: Choice-free countable route: enumerations, canonical binary tree, Konig's lemma (thm:p06-konig-infinity), result thm:prop-compactness; the unrestricted case is left to the BPI calibration.
